Anthropic is hiring a Head of GTM Narrative because AI can write plausible text but not the surprising insight that only humans can produce.

What the heck is a "GTM Engineer"?

Two years ago, "GTM engineer" was barely a job title. In 2025, postings for it grew 205%, and the top payers like Vercel and OpenAI are now north of $250k for one. It's become one of the fastest-growing roles in B2B. So what actually is it?

The name got popularised by Clay around 2023, though the work itself isn't new. Companies like Ramp, Stripe and Figma had technical people sitting inside their revenue teams for years, usually filed under growth or RevOps.

SaaS .Group is Hiring 📢

Role: Brand and Content Specialist
Location: Remote  
Pay: Competitive

- 3 to 5 years of experience in a brand, content, or marketing role, ideally within B2B SaaS.
- An equal balance of writing and design skills: you are strong at both and do not see them as separate disciplines
- Comfortable working in Figma and actively using AI tools in your day-to-day work
